title: verifySession returns null for expired sessions
goal: Make `verifySession` in src/auth/session.ts return null for an expired session instead of throwing, so callers can treat 'no session' uniformly. Keep the signature unchanged.

acceptance.description: An expired token gives null, not an exception.
acceptance.testName: verifySession returns null for an expired session

acceptance.description: A valid token still gives its session.
acceptance.testName: verifySession still returns a session that has time left

hints: Add the acceptance tests in tests/session-expiry.test.ts.

title: Audit expired-session logins
goal: Write an audit log entry with event "session.expired" whenever a login request (`handleLogin` in src/auth/login.ts) arrives with an expired session. The response must still be the `expired` response.

acceptance.description: An expired session gives one session.expired audit entry and the expired response.
acceptance.testName: an expired session writes an audit entry and returns expired

acceptance.description: No token, or an unknown token, is unauthorized and writes no session.expired entry.
acceptance.testName: a missing or unknown session writes no expired entry

acceptance.description: A valid session writes no session.expired entry.
acceptance.testName: a valid session writes no expired entry

hints: Your plan depends on how verifySession reports an expired session. Assert it: adopt `a-session-throws`.

title: Count expired sessions in metrics
goal: Increment `metrics.sessionsExpired` whenever `authenticate` in src/api/handlers.ts sees a request with an expired session.

acceptance.description: Each request with an expired session adds one to metrics.sessionsExpired and authenticates as expired.
acceptance.testName: a request with an expired session is counted

acceptance.description: Valid, missing and unknown tokens leave the counter alone.
acceptance.testName: valid and anonymous requests are not counted as expired

hints: Your plan depends on how verifySession reports an expired session. Assert it: adopt `a-session-throws`.

title: Add an X-Session-TTL header
goal: Add an `x-session-ttl` header to authenticated responses (`withSessionHeaders` in src/api/responses.ts): the whole seconds left before the session expires.

acceptance.description: withSessionHeaders sets x-session-ttl to the whole seconds remaining.
acceptance.testName: authenticated responses carry the seconds left in the session

acceptance.description: A routed, authenticated request carries the header.
acceptance.testName: the header appears on API responses

hints: `sessionTtl` in src/auth/session.ts already computes the time left.

title: Round tax half to even
goal: Invoices must round tax half to even. Make `taxFor` in src/billing/tax.ts round exact halves to the even minor unit, and make `computeTotal` in src/billing/invoice.ts use `taxFor` instead of rounding by itself.

acceptance.description: 12.5 becomes 12, 17.5 becomes 18.
acceptance.testName: taxFor rounds exact halves to the even minor unit

acceptance.description: Amounts that are not exact halves round to nearest, as before.
acceptance.testName: taxFor rounds everything else to the nearest minor unit

acceptance.description: An invoice's tax matches taxFor.
acceptance.testName: computeTotal uses the same rounding

title: Stop discount stacking
goal: Change `applyDiscounts` in src/billing/discount.ts so that at most one percentage discount (the largest) and one fixed discount (the largest) apply to an invoice. The percentage comes off first, then the fixed amount, and the total discount never exceeds the subtotal.

acceptance.description: Two percentage codes do not stack.
acceptance.testName: only the largest percentage discount applies

acceptance.description: Two fixed codes do not stack.
acceptance.testName: only the largest fixed discount applies

acceptance.description: The result does not depend on the order of the discounts.
acceptance.testName: the percentage comes off first, whatever the order given

acceptance.description: The discount is capped at the subtotal.
acceptance.testName: the discount never exceeds the subtotal

hints: `computeTotal` in src/billing/invoice.ts is the main caller; check that invoice totals still add up.

title: Add a canAccess role check
goal: Add `canAccess(roles, resource)` to src/users/roles.ts. It returns true when any of the user's roles is at least the minimum role for the resource. Resources and their minimum roles: "profile" needs viewer, "invoices" needs member, "billing" needs billing, "members" needs admin.

acceptance.description: Each resource opens at its minimum role and not below it.
acceptance.testName: each resource has a minimum role

acceptance.description: An admin can open every resource.
acceptance.testName: a higher role can open everything below it

acceptance.description: Multiple roles and the empty list behave sensibly.
acceptance.testName: any one of several roles is enough, and no roles means no access

title: Limit display name length
goal: Make `validateProfile` in src/users/profile.ts reject a display name longer than 64 visible characters, reporting the problem on the `displayName` field.

acceptance.description: 64 characters is fine.
acceptance.testName: a display name of 64 characters is accepted

acceptance.description: 65 characters gives one problem on displayName.
acceptance.testName: a display name of 65 characters is rejected

acceptance.description: An emoji counts as one character.
acceptance.testName: length is counted in visible characters

title: Format zero-decimal currencies
goal: Make `formatMoney` in src/billing/currency.ts respect each currency's number of decimals: yen has none, so 1200 yen is "¥1200", not "¥12.00".

acceptance.description: JPY amounts have no decimal point.
acceptance.testName: yen is formatted with no fraction

acceptance.description: USD, EUR and GBP format as before.
acceptance.testName: two-decimal currencies are unchanged

title: Restart invoice numbers each year
goal: Make `nextInvoiceNumber` in src/billing/invoice.ts restart the sequence at 0001 when `issuedAt` falls in a later calendar year than the previous invoice number.

acceptance.description: INV-2026-0041 is followed by INV-2027-0001 in 2027.
acceptance.testName: numbering restarts at 0001 in a new calendar year

acceptance.description: Within a year the sequence counts up.
acceptance.testName: numbering continues within the same year

acceptance.description: No previous number gives 0001.
acceptance.testName: the first invoice ever is 0001

title: Rate-limit expired-session requests
goal: Count each request that arrives with an expired session against the client's rate limit (`guardRequest` in src/auth/rate-limit.ts), so a client replaying an expired token is eventually turned away. Valid sessions and requests without a session must not be counted.

acceptance.description: With a limit of 3, the fourth expired-session request is refused.
acceptance.testName: requests with an expired session count against the limit

acceptance.description: A signed-in client is never limited by this rule.
acceptance.testName: valid sessions are not counted

acceptance.description: Requests with no token or an unknown token are not counted.
acceptance.testName: anonymous and unknown tokens are not counted

hints: Your plan depends on how verifySession reports an expired session. Assert it: adopt `a-session-throws`.

title: Require a digit in passwords
goal: Enforce the `requireDigit` rule in `checkPasswordPolicy` (src/auth/password.ts): when it is on, a password with no digit gets the "needs_digit" issue. Turn the rule on in `DEFAULT_PASSWORD_POLICY`.

acceptance.description: The default policy reports needs_digit.
acceptance.testName: a password with no digit is rejected by default

acceptance.description: A strong password with a digit has no issues.
acceptance.testName: a password with a digit is accepted

acceptance.description: With requireDigit false, no digit is needed.
acceptance.testName: the digit rule can be turned off
